name: MakerPI S6 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
;===== machine: Makerpi S6 ========================
;===== date: 20230707 =====================
G28
;===== reset machine status =================
G91
G1 Z5 F300;
G90
M220 S100 ;Reset Feedrate
M221 S100 ;Reset Flowrate
M221 X0 Y0 Z0 ; turn off soft endstop to prevent protential logic problem
M204 S10000 ; init ACC set to 10m/s^2

;===== heatbed preheat ====================
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ;set bed temp
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ;wait for bed temp

;=============turn on fans to prevent PLA jamming=================
{if filament_type[initial_extruder]=="PLA"}
    {if (bed_temperature[initial_extruder] >45)||(bed_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder] >45)}
    M106 P3 S180
    {endif};Prevent PLA from jamming
{endif}
M106 P2 S100 ; turn on big fan ,to cool down toolhead

;===== prepare print temperature and material ==========
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ;set extruder temp
G91
G0 Z10 F1200
G90
G28 X
G1 X210 F12000
G1 Y0
G1 Y5 F3000

;=============turn on fans to prevent PLA jamming=================
{if filament_type[initial_extruder]=="PLA"}
    {if (bed_temperature[initial_extruder] >45)||(bed_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder] >45)}
    M106 P3 S180
    {endif};Prevent PLA from jamming
{endif}
M106 P2 S100 ; turn on big fan ,to cool down toolhead

;===== bed leveling ==================================
M109 S140
; Always pass `ADAPTIVE_MARGIN=0` because Orca has already handled `adaptive_bed_mesh_margin` internally
; Make sure to set ADAPTIVE to 0 otherwise Klipper will use it's own adaptive bed mesh logic
BED_MESH_CLEAR
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE mesh_min={adaptive_bed_mesh_min[0]},{adaptive_bed_mesh_min[1]} mesh_max={adaptive_bed_mesh_max[0]},{adaptive_bed_mesh_max[1]} ALGORITHM=[bed_mesh_algo] PROBE_COUNT={bed_mesh_probe_count[0]},{bed_mesh_probe_count[1]} ADAPTIVE=0 ADAPTIVE_MARGIN=0
;===== bed leveling end ================================

;===== nozzle load line ===============================
G90
M83
G1 X-5 Y1 Z0.8 F18000;Move to start position
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]}
PRINT_START EXTRUDER=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] BED=[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
G1 Z0.2
G0 E2 F300
G0 Y192 E15 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/(0.3*0.5)     * 60}
G0 X6 E0.700 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/(0.3*0.5)/ 4 * 60}
G0 Y191.5
G0 E0.2
G0 X-4.5 E0.700
G0 Y1 E15 F{outer_wall_volumetric_speed/(0.3*0.5)     * 60}
M400

;===== for Textured PEI Plate , lower the nozzle as the nozzle was touching topmost of the texture when homing ==
;curr_bed_type={curr_bed_type}
{if curr_bed_type=="Textured PEI Plate"}
G29.1 Z{-0.04} ; for Textured PEI Plate
{endif}
;========turn off light and wait extrude temperature =============
M106 S0 ; turn off fan
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off big fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber fan
